title: Soviet military exercise drew UFOs once nuclear weapons were brought in

tellings.quote: he's he's on video on the internet saying that uh at some point during the Soviet era he was part of a military exercise uh that was intentionally designed to try to attract UFOs

plain: During the Soviet era, a military exercise was set up on purpose to try to attract UFOs, and the story goes that they turned up once nuclear weapons were brought in. Robert Hastings, a researcher who studies UFO reports at nuclear weapons sites, passes this on from a retired Soviet army colonel whom he does not name, and he says the colonel tells it himself in a video on the internet. Hastings tells it because, if true, it would mean UFOs are drawn to nuclear weapons outside the United States too.
